overview.description: The XFUNDS Memory Income ETF (DRMY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in companies engaged in the development and manufacture of semiconductor memory products. The fund also employs various options strategies to generate additional income DRMY was launched on Jul 16, 2026 and is issued by XFUNDS.
